# Form task

[← All actions](README.md)

Hands a form to a user or a task group (fields such as text, numbers, dates, dropdowns and records, and repeater sections that are tables with several rows), waits in the background until it is completed, and continues with one output per field and, per repeater, its rows and their count. An optional preview next to the form shows HTML or a document that follows the entries.

> **Early access.** This step is part of AutoFlow Tasks and ships with the release after 27.0.40. AutoFlow Tasks is rolled out in stages: it is switched on for selected customers first (portal feature flag `tasks`) and for everyone else a few weeks later. Until it is switched on for an environment, the step is hidden in the editor and publishing refuses it. Only use it when the user confirms AutoFlow Tasks is enabled for them.

| | |

| Enum name | `FormTask` |
| Ordinal | `"action": 5564426` |
| Category | Tasks |
| Terminating | `false` |
| Group / edges | No |
| Availability | Dark-launched (AutoFlow Tasks). Background triggers only, the same list as the [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#where-it-can-be-used). |

## What it does

On its first run the step builds the form and creates a task in the AutoFlow task inbox. The task's subject is the step's `description` (or the flow's description if that is empty), and the card shows `instructions` above the form. Everything on the form is a snapshot taken at this moment:

- **Prefills** (`value`) are resolved against the flow: SmartFields, SmartFormulas, SmartDates.
- **Dropdown values** (`options`) are split at `;` and line breaks. An entry that is a single SmartField holding several values (an array) adds each of them.
- **Record fields** offer the records of `tableNo` that match `filters` (filter values resolved against the flow), in primary-key order, at most **1,000**. Each reads as its primary key plus its `Name` or `Description` field (`10000 – Adatum`).
- **Repeater sections** get one prefilled row per record or value of `rowsFrom`, at most **1,000**. A column whose `value` starts with the section's `rowsFrom` name (e.g. `{{FindCust_results.name}}` for `rowsFrom` `{{FindCust_results}}`) is resolved against that row; any other prefill is the same in every row. Without `rowsFrom` the repeater starts empty.

Fields without a `section` (or with a section name that does not exist) go into a section without a heading at the top of the form. The run then **parks**. Waiting works exactly as for the [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#what-it-does): the task is checked every poll interval (default 5 minutes), the run continues at once when the user the flow runs as completes it, the step fails on a cancelled task, each loop pass creates its own task, and a retried run reuses its task.

On the card, **Complete** checks the required fields and refuses values it cannot read (a date or number, a dropdown value that is not offered unless `freeText` is on, a record that is not in the list). **Save draft** keeps what was entered so far, also with required fields empty, and the task stays open for whoever opens it next.

The preview (`previewKind` 1 or 2) is **not** a snapshot: Core renders it live on the card while the person fills in the form.

## Where it can be used

Background triggers only. The trigger list, the webhook `WaitForResponse` caveat and the SubFlow rule are the same as for the [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#where-it-can-be-used).

## Licensing

Anyone can be an assignee or a group member: any enabled Business Central user, with no seat needed. **Completing** (and saving a draft of) a form task needs a paid AutoFlow licence **and an AutoFlow Tasks seat**. Unlike the Selection task, the form task has no "user who started the flow" assignment (`assignType` 2).

## Configuration

| key | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instructions` | string | yes | – | What to fill in and why, shown above the form. Supports SmartFields `{{..}}`, SmartFormulas `[[..]]` and SmartControls `{#..#}`. |
| `assignType` | integer | no | `0` | `0` = user, `1` = task group. Any other value counts as user. |
| `assignee` | string | yes | – | Type 0: a Business Central **user name** (or user security ID). Type 1: a **task group code**. Case-insensitive and trimmed. Can be a SmartField resolved at runtime. |
| `dueDate` | string | no | `""` | A date (`yyyy-mm-dd` is safest) or a SmartDate. If it doesn't resolve to a date, it is ignored silently. |
| `sections` | array | no | `[]` | Rows of `{ "caption", "name", "kind", "rowsFrom", "allowAdd" }`, described below. |
| `fields` | array | yes | `[]` | Rows of `{ "section", "caption", "name", "type", "required", "value", "options", "freeText", "tableNo", "filters" }`, described below. At least one field is needed. |
| `previewKind` | integer | no | `0` | `0` = no preview, `1` = HTML (`previewHtml`), `2` = document (`previewDocument`). |
| `previewHtml` | string | no | `""` | `previewKind` 1: HTML with SmartFields, rendered live next to the form. See [Preview](#preview). |
| `previewDocument` | string | no | `""` | `previewKind` 2: exactly one placeholder `{{name}}` that points to an incoming document attachment or an AutoFlow document. |

The editor always writes every key.

Section rows:

| field | description |
|---|---|
| `caption` | Heading on the task card. |
| `name` | How fields and outputs refer to the section. Letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique across all field and section names. The editor fills an empty name from the caption (camelCase: `Order lines` → `orderLines`). |
| `kind` | `"normal"` (fields one below the other) or `"repeater"` (a table filled in row by row). Anything else counts as normal. |
| `rowsFrom` | Repeater only: exactly one placeholder `{{name}}` that points to records or values (a Find Records `results`, a collection, an iterator). One prefilled row per entry. `""`: no prefilled rows. |
| `allowAdd` | Repeater only: `true` lets the person add and delete rows. `false`: the prefilled rows stay as they are. |

Field rows:

| field | description |
|---|---|
| `section` | The `name` of the section the field belongs to. `""` = the section at the top. |
| `caption` | Label on the task card. |
| `name` | Output name. Same rules as section names (letters and digits, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters, unique). The editor fills an empty name from the caption. Always set it in hand-written JSON. |
| `type` | `"text"`, `"multiline"`, `"boolean"`, `"integer"`, `"decimal"`, `"date"`, `"datetime"`, `"dropdown"` or `"reference"` (a record). Empty counts as text. |
| `required` | `true`: the task can only be completed once the field is filled in. |
| `value` | Prefill (SmartText). In a repeater, start it with the section's `rowsFrom` name to resolve it per row. For `reference` fields: exactly one placeholder `{{name}}` that holds a record (the first of an array is taken); anything else prefills nothing. |
| `options` | `dropdown` only: the values, separated by `;` or line breaks (SmartText; an entry that is one SmartField holding an array adds every value). |
| `freeText` | `dropdown` only: `true` also accepts values that are not in the list. |
| `tableNo` | `reference` only: the table to choose from. `0` for other types. |
| `filters` | `reference` only: `[{ "fieldNo": 1, "filter": "<filter expression>" }]` on fields of `tableNo`; `filter` supports SmartText. `[]` = no filter. |

### Preview

`previewHtml` can use earlier steps' outputs and the form's **own** fields, named the way later steps see them: `{{<slug>_<field>}}`, e.g. `{{CustForm_paymentTerms.description}}` for a record field. A repeater's rows can be looped over with `{#for {{<slug>_<section>}} #}…{{<slug>_<section>.<column>}}…{#endfor#}`; outside a loop `{{<slug>_<section>.<column>}}` is the first row and `{{<slug>_<section>Count}}` the number of rows. The template is resolved live on the card, not when the task is created.

`previewDocument` can point to one of the form's own record fields (`{{<slug>_<field>}}`), so the preview shows the document the person picked.

## Outputs

| name | type | tableNo | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<field>` | value / reference | `reference`: the field's `tableNo` | One per field of a **normal** section (including the top section), by `name`. Values are text in XML format: `true`/`false`, `12`, `1.25`, `2026-11-02`, `2026-11-02T09:30:00`. A `reference` field holds the chosen record; when it was left empty, the output is not set. |
| `<section>` | reference | `5564267` | One per **repeater**: its rows as SmartObjects (`mse365 SK SmartObject`), shaped like Find Records: `{{<slug>_<section>}}` is the first row, `{{<slug>_<section>[0]}}`, `{{<slug>_<section>[1]}}`, … each one. The columns are the fields of the section: `{{<slug>_lines.quantity}}`. Not set when the repeater has no rows. |
| `<section>Count` | value | – | Number of rows of the repeater. |
| `completedBy` | value | – | User name of who completed the task. |
| `task` | reference | `5564323` | The task record (`mse365 AF-CO Task`). |

The outputs are written once the task is completed. Output names are cut at 30 characters. The editor declares the outputs in this order: field outputs (in `fields` order), then per repeater `<section>` and `<section>Count`, then `completedBy` and `task`. A repeater output carries its columns, which [Read task repeater](ReadTaskRepeater.md) and For Each pick up:

```jsonc
{ "name": "lines", "type": "reference", "tableNo": 5564267,
  "columns": [ { "name": "item", "type": "value" }, { "name": "customer", "type": "reference", "tableNo": 18 } ] }
```

Write the same `columns` (one entry per field of the section, in `fields` order; `tableNo` only for `reference` fields) in hand-written JSON. To work with the rows, loop over `{{<slug>_<section>}}` with For Each and read the current row with [Read task repeater](ReadTaskRepeater.md).

## Validation

| stage | severity | rule | message |
|---|---|---|---|
| editor | error | `instructions` or `assignee` is empty | `Please fill in the highlighted fields.` |
| publish | error | AutoFlow Tasks is not enabled for the environment | `The task step '%1' cannot be published: AutoFlow Tasks is not enabled for this environment.` |
| publish | error | The trigger cannot wait (see [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#where-it-can-be-used)) | `The task step '%1' cannot be used in this flow: its trigger runs while the user works on the record (or answers right away), so the flow cannot wait for a person there. Use a trigger that runs in the background, such as a record trigger, a schedule or a manual start.` |

`%1` is the step **id**. The step's own design-time checks are not run: `Enter the instructions for the person who fills in the form.`, `Choose who completes the task: a user or a task group.`, `Add at least one field to the form.`, `The name '%1' is used more than once. Field and section names must be unique.`, `The name '%1' is not valid: use letters and digits only, at most %2 characters, starting with a letter.`, `The field '%1' is in section '%2', which does not exist.`, `Choose the table of the record field '%1'.`, `Enter the values of the dropdown '%1'.`, `The prefill of '%1' must use the rows of its section, for example {{%2.Name}}.`, `The repeater section '%1' has no fields.` and `Choose the document the preview shows.` Follow these rules anyway: breaking them gives broken forms or outputs, not an error.

## Runtime errors

| condition | message |
|---|---|
| The form has no fields | `The form has no fields.` |
| A record field's filter cannot be applied (unknown field, filter that does not fit the field type) | `The filter of the record field '%1' cannot be applied to field %2.` |
| Assignee empty / user missing / user disabled / group missing | The same messages as the [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#runtime-errors). |
| Tasks switched off, inline frame, SubFlow, cancelled task | The same messages as the [Approval task](ApprovalTask.md#runtime-errors). |

## Example

A task group completes a new customer's data: payment terms (a record of table 3), a credit limit prefilled from the customer, a priority dropdown, and a repeater of contacts.

```json
{
  "id": "8A3F1C52-6E2D-4B7A-9C0E-1D2F3A4B5C61",
  "type": "action",
  "action": 5564426,
  "description": "Complete customer data",
  "slug": "CustForm",
  "iconUrl": "https://statics.autoflow.mse365.de/icons/forms.svg",
  "terminating": false,
  "configuration": {
    "instructions": "Complete the data of customer {{trigger_Rec.no}} {{trigger_Rec.name}}.",
    "assignType": 1,
    "assignee": "SALES",
    "dueDate": "",
    "sections": [
      { "caption": "Contacts", "name": "contacts", "kind": "repeater", "rowsFrom": "", "allowAdd": true }
    ],
    "fields": [
      { "section": "", "caption": "Payment terms", "name": "paymentTerms", "type": "reference", "required": true, "value": "", "options": "", "freeText": false, "tableNo": 3, "filters": [] },
      { "section": "", "caption": "Credit limit", "name": "creditLimit", "type": "decimal", "required": false, "value": "{{trigger_Rec.creditlimitlcy}}", "options": "", "freeText": false, "tableNo": 0, "filters": [] },
      { "section": "", "caption": "Priority", "name": "priority", "type": "dropdown", "required": true, "value": "Normal", "options": "Low;Normal;High", "freeText": false, "tableNo": 0, "filters": [] },
      { "section": "contacts", "caption": "Name", "name": "name", "type": "text", "required": true, "value": "", "options": "", "freeText": false, "tableNo": 0, "filters": [] },
      { "section": "contacts", "caption": "E-mail", "name": "email", "type": "text", "required": false, "value": "", "options": "", "freeText": false, "tableNo": 0, "filters": [] }
    ],
    "previewKind": 0,
    "previewHtml": "",
    "previewDocument": ""
  },
  "outputs": [
    { "name": "paymentTerms", "type": "reference", "tableNo": 3 },
    { "name": "creditLimit", "type": "value" },
    { "name": "priority", "type": "value" },
    { "name": "contacts", "type": "reference", "tableNo": 5564267, "columns": [ { "name": "name", "type": "value" }, { "name": "email", "type": "value" } ] },
    { "name": "contactsCount", "type": "value" },
    { "name": "completedBy", "type": "value" },
    { "name": "task", "type": "reference", "tableNo": 5564323 }
  ]
}
```

`SALES` must be an existing task group, and the `trigger_…` placeholders are illustrative.

## Gotchas

- Tell the user which **task group** or user the flow expects, and that completing needs an AutoFlow Tasks seat.
- The task's subject is the step's `description`, so make it meaningful ("Complete customer data", not "Form").
- Keep field and section names unique, letters and digits only, at most 20 characters. Nothing checks this when the flow is saved or published.
- A repeater column's prefill must start with the section's `rowsFrom` name to differ per row. `{{OtherStep_value}}` gives every row the same value.
- Repeater fields have no outputs of their own. Read them through the repeater output (`{{<slug>_<section>.<column>}}`, For Each, [Read task repeater](ReadTaskRepeater.md)).
- Record fields and repeaters offer at most 1,000 records/rows. Narrow the table with `filters` or the `rowsFrom` list with Find Records filters.
- Values are captured when the task is created (except the preview). They do not update while the task waits.
